title: Create a reusable workflow reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for create a reusable workflow should include: workflow_call:, uses:.
answer.example:
# .github/workflows/reusable-checks.yml
name: Reusable checks
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      python-version:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "3.12"
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python --version
answer.verification: A caller can reference this file as a reusable workflow and optionally set `python-version`. The snippet is a minimal illustration; add setup and test steps for a real project.
